title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-05
source: 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips(Recorded In Venue By Bear on a Sony 770 Reel 2 Reel)-1st Generation Cassettes Transferred By Dick Latvala(Master Reel Playback on a Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck no Dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer(Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon-Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise circa late 1990's); Zero Gen DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Digital Out @ 16/44.1kHz-Digital Audio Labs Card deluxe-WAV @ 16/44.1KHz; Editing(Adobe Audition CC)-Mastering & Processing(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name) JW:February 2015

ai_review.summary: Good-quality mic‑stage recording of a mid‑70s Fillmore West show with standout St. Stephen, Hard to Handle and an acoustic I Know You Riders.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a vivid mid‑1970 Fillmore West performance; reviewers praise the detail and separation despite it being a stage‑mic source rather than a true audience or soundboard tape. Highlights include an intense St. Stephen, a fiery Hard to Handle and a lovely acoustic I Know You Riders, while the Cryptical cut is noted as rough and some monitor/drum balance issues are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give high star ratings and emphasize strong musical moments; technical quality is good with only minor flaws, leading to a solid overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stage‑mic recording with slight speaker boominess and drums mic'd too loud; high‑pitched cymbal feedback appears around The Other One, but overall the mix is detailed, well‑EQ’d and instruments are nicely separated.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical mid‑1970 Fillmore West two‑set flow; acoustic numbers open the show and a powerful second set delivers intense jams, fitting well within the celebrated June run.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drums were mic'd too loud, creating an unbalanced mix; some high‑pitched cymbal feedback is audible during The Other One.
